## Schema: `purchasing.vendor`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Key | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-----|-------------|
| `businessentityid` | integer | NO | **PK** | Primary key reference to the business entity |
| `accountnumber` | varchar(15) | NO | | Vendor account identifier |
| `name` | varchar(50) | NO | | Vendor name |
| `creditrating` | smallint | NO | | Credit rating score |
| `preferredvendorstatus` | boolean | NO | | Whether vendor is preferred |
| `activeflag` | boolean | NO | | Whether vendor is active |
| `purchasingwebserviceurl` | varchar(1024) | YES | | Web service URL for purchasing |
| `modifieddate` | timestamp | NO | | Last modification date |

---

### Related Tables in `purchasing` Schema:
- `productvendor` - Product-vendor relationships
- `purchaseorderdetail` - Purchase order line items
- `purchaseorderheader` - Purchase order headers
- `shipmethod` - Shipping methods
- `vvendorwithaddresses` - Vendor with address info (view)
- `vvendorwithcontacts` - Vendor with contact info (view)
